ownerCorrectionQ4.sentenceRemovedVerbatim: This packet has checked, and says what it found rather than guessing. The compiled Utah state profile in this repository records BCI's published expungement FAQ as saying that "eligible conviction, plea-in-abeyance, or special certificates may require an additional $65 per case; no certificate issuance fee is required for dismissals, acquittals, or declinations". Your route is a charge ended by the limitations period. That is not a conviction, a plea in abeyance or a special certificate, and it is not a dismissal, an acquittal or a declination either, so neither half of that sentence is about your case and this packet will not read it across to you.
ownerCorrectionQ4.sentenceAddedVerbatim: This packet has checked what this repository holds, and it will not put a figure in front of you that no form in this packet prints. Utah sets BCI's amounts through the Utah Code 63J-1-504 process rather than by a number in the expungement statute, and the controlling Utah design records the current BCI application and issuance amounts as an open, release-blocking question. Nothing enclosed here prints a certificate issuance amount for a charge ended by the limitations period, and a secondary figure is not something this packet will pass on to you as a price. The Bureau of Criminal Identification is the office that states the current amount.
ownerCorrectionQ4.theRefusalIsTheDesignsOwn: data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/UT.memo.json track ut_pet_limitations records the current BCI application and issuance amounts as an unresolved question at impact release_blocker, because 'the statute sets them through the Section 63J-1-504 process rather than by number, and the secondary figures of 65 dollars each are unconfirmed'. The added sentence carries that refusal and names BCI as the office that states the amount.

whatWasDeliberatelyNotCommitted.raster: The Utah host rejects --no-raster: runUtahCompletenessRepair throws 'unsupported option' on any argv entry beginning with -- except --check, which itself throws. The family was therefore built normally and the locally emitted raster discarded with git checkout -- <family>/raster <family>/build-status.json <family>/reports/rendered-artifacts.json. 22 of the 38 page PNGs had been re-rendered by this container's browser at rasterEngineVersion 24.02.0 against the committed 26.05.0; none of that is central acceptance and none of it is committed. git status shows no raster, no build-status.json and no rendered-artifacts.json change.
whatWasDeliberatelyNotCommitted.whyRenderedArtifactsJsonWasAlsoRestored: Its entire diff was raster evidence - 38 engineVersion fields, 2 rasterEngineVersion fields and the 22 changed page hashes with their byte lengths. Every non-raster field, including both fixture hashes, was byte-identical, verified by structural comparison after stripping rasterPages and rasterEngineVersion. Committing it would have left the recorded page hashes pointing at PNGs this lane had just discarded.
whatWasDeliberatelyNotCommitted.centralQueues: RASTER_QUEUE.json and MASTER_QUEUE.json were not opened for writing and are unchanged.

determinism.nonDeterministicOutputs: Only the raster PNGs and the raster fields of reports/rendered-artifacts.json, which is why they were discarded rather than committed.
